title: Inspect code coverage by the technical inventory
statement: As an Architect or Developer, I can report which code is accounted for by Systems and Components and which is uncovered so I can identify gaps in the application's technical documentation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The coverage report identifies the source revision and code scope being measured and reports covered and uncovered code in that scope.
Each covered code range identifies the System or Component references that account for it, and each uncovered range identifies the source location needing attention.
Stale or unresolved references and overlapping references are reported separately from current coverage; absent evidence does not count as coverage.
Code referenced by multiple inventory entities contributes only once to the overall covered-code total.
